title: LuminaAura
description: A collection of mystical artifacts that grant unique passive abilities while held in hand.
body:
**LuminaAura is a lightweight collection of mystical artifacts designed to enhance your gameplay without cluttering your world with complex magic systems. Each artifact provides a unique passive utility when held in your main hand.**

Core Mechanics
Simply hold an artifact in your main hand, and its aura will activate immediately. The effects are dynamic, responsive, and vanish the moment you switch to another item.


Key Features

Performance Focused: No laggy rendering or excessive particle spawns.

Intuitive: Works automatically based on your active item.

Vanilla-Friendly: Designed to fit perfectly into any survival modpack.

Seamless Integration: Clean UI and straightforward mechanics.

Future Plans

Expand the collection with more unique utility artifacts.

Implement custom upgrade paths for existing items.

Add unique sound and visual cues for each artifact.
